New piece with Charles Sun in @JamestownTweets China Brief. On the evidence, Beijing messes around with you a great deal.

The same structure shows up across four unrelated areas. Beijing deemed a product harmful, restricts its sale at home, applies the same rules in full to imports, then lets it leave the country largely unchecked.

Flavored e-cigarettes. Banned outright at home. PRC customs recorded RMB 26 billion in shipments to the United States in 2024; U.S. customs recorded $333 million arriving. No enforcement action against exporters has been made public.

Children's goods. Inspectors in Seoul found sandals with phthalates at over 280 times the legal limit, sold on Shein, AliExpress, and Temu. South Korea caps those chemicals at the same level the PRC does.

LLMs. Foreign models cannot serve PRC users without filing. PRC open-weight models deploy abroad with the censorship written into the weights.

effective_posts.translation_zh:
2009 年，习近平向世界作出三项保证：中国“不输出革命”，“不输出饥饿和贫困”，也“不去折腾你们”。

与 Charles Sun 在 @JamestownTweets China Brief 上发表的新文章。从证据来看，北京可没少折腾你们。

同样的结构出现在四个互不相关的领域。北京认定某种产品有害，限制其在国内销售，将同样规则完整适用于进口，然后却让它基本不受检查地离开中国。

芬太尼前体。用于阻止向指定国家出口化学品的许可工具自 2005 年以来就已存在。缅甸、老挝和阿富汗多年来一直在该名单上。美国、墨西哥和加拿大是在釜山峰会后 11 天被加入的。北京峰会后 8 天，又增加了三种化学品。

调味电子烟。在国内被彻底禁止。中国海关记录显示，2024 年运往美国的货物价值为 260 亿人民币；美国海关记录显示，到货金额为 3.33 亿美元。尚未公开任何针对出口商的执法行动。

儿童用品。首尔的检查人员发现，在 Shein、AliExpress 和 Temu 上销售的凉鞋中，邻苯二甲酸酯含量超过法定限值 280 多倍。韩国对这些化学品的限量与中国相同。

LLMs。外国模型未备案不得向中国用户提供服务。中国开放权重模型在海外部署时，审查机制已写入权重之中。

JD.com (09618.HK is executing a definitive pivot from margin-crushing price wars to technology-driven profitability. In Q2 2026, the e-commerce giant reported a 2.9% YoY revenue decline to RMB 346.4B ($51.1B), yet non-GAAP net profit surged 20.8% to RMB 8.9B. This divergence marks a structural shift: slashing inefficient subsidies while aggressively scaling AI infrastructure.

Bull Case

JD is successfully trading empty top-line calories for sustainable margin expansion. By reducing per-order subsidies, JD Food Delivery losses narrowed by over 50% YoY. Simultaneously, the company reallocated capital into technology, driving a 37.7% surge in R&D spending to RMB 7.3B. AI integration is yielding immediate operational leverage—JD Retail’s operating margin hit a record 4.6%, supported by the Jingdong Logistics MetaBrain LLM and AI-driven ad targeting that boosted platform and advertising services revenue by 8.3%.

Bear Case

The core top-line remains under severe macroeconomic pressure. Electronics and home appliance sales contracted 11.8% YoY, dragged down by fading national trade-in subsidies and rising upstream component costs. Total revenue contracted for the first time since its 2014 listing, highlighting the risk of losing market share to aggressive lower-tier competitors.

Key Metrics (Q2 2026)

Total Revenue: RMB 346.4B (-2.9% YoY)

Non-GAAP Net Profit: RMB 8.9B (+20.8% YoY)

JD.com（09618.HK 正在从压缩利润率的价格战，果断转向由技术驱动的盈利能力。2026 年第二季度，这家电商巨头报告营收同比下降 2.9%，至人民币 3464 亿元（511 亿美元），但非 GAAP 净利润飙升 20.8%，至人民币 89 亿元。这种分化标志着一种结构性转变：削减低效补贴，同时积极扩大 AI 基础设施。

看多理由

京东正在成功用空洞的营收增长换取可持续的利润率扩张。通过减少每单补贴，京东外卖亏损同比收窄超过 50%。与此同时，公司将资本重新配置到技术领域，推动研发支出激增 37.7%，至人民币 73 亿元。AI 整合正在带来即时的运营杠杆——在京东物流 MetaBrain 大模型和 AI 驱动的广告定向支持下，京东零售的经营利润率达到创纪录的 4.6%，平台及广告服务收入增长 8.3%。

看空理由

核心营收仍面临严重的宏观经济压力。受国家以旧换新补贴减弱和上游零部件成本上升拖累，电子产品和家用电器销售同比收缩 11.8%。总收入自 2014 年上市以来首次收缩，凸显出市场份额流失给激进的低线竞争对手的风险。

关键指标（2026 年第二季度）

总收入：人民币 3464 亿元（同比 -2.9%）

非 GAAP 净利润：人民币 89 亿元（同比 +20.8%）

京东物流收入：人民币 681 亿元（同比 +24.3%）

营销费用：同比减少约人民币 67 亿元
